description: InfluenceKit is an influencer marketing platform for brands, agencies, and creators. It supports campaign management, creator discovery, cross-platform content statistics, and shareable reporting.
summary: InfluenceKit exposes a REST API at `https://api.influencekit.com/v1` with an OpenAPI spec, plus an OAuth-protected MCP server at `https://api.influencekit.com/mcp` and a public signup MCP endpoint at `https://api.influencekit.com/mcp/public`.
